# Structurizr on-premises installation

> The Structurizr on-premises installation will not receive any further updates - please migrate to [server](https://docs.structurizr.com/server) for new features, bug fixes, and security updates. See [Introducing Structurizr vNext](https://www.patreon.com/posts/146923136) for more details.
